extras: Desktop-only (uses the navigator.clipboard.write API with ClipboardItem).
intentEvidence: This plugin makes Cmd+C just work: select the image embed, copy, paste anywhere.
motivation: To allow users to paste images directly into other applications (Slack, Mail, Figma, etc.) without needing to right-click and copy from the rendered preview.
problem: By default, selecting an image embed in source mode copies the wikilink text instead of the image data, making it difficult to paste the image directly into other applications.
summary: Intercept the system copy event to copy the actual image binary to the clipboard when an image embed is selected in source mode or Live Preview.
